map.输入初始投资（负值）与各期现金流，计算使 NPV=0 的内部收益率: Enter the initial investment (negative) and each period's cash flow to compute the IRR that makes NPV=0
map.CFₜ 为第 t 期现金流（期初投入为负），r 为折现率。IRR 反映项目实际收: CFₜ is the cash flow at period t (initial outlay negative), r is the discount rate. IRR reflects the project's actual rate of return.
map.IRR 是使项目净现值 NPV 等于 0 的折现率，反映投资项目的年化收益率: IRR is the discount rate that makes a project's net present value NPV equal to 0, reflecting its annualized return
map.若现金流存在多个符号变化，可能出现多重 IRR，本工具返回首次收敛值: If cash flows change sign multiple times, multiple IRRs may exist; this tool returns the first converged value
map.先阅读IRR (Internal Rate of Return) Calcula: First read the input instructions of the IRR (Internal Rate of Return) Calculator, run it once with a reproducible example and record the result.
map.示例：初始 -10 万、其后 5 期各回款 3 万: Example: initial −100k, then 30k returned each of 5 periods
map.IRR = 15.24%；与折现率 8% 下的 NPV = 19,781.30: IRR = 15.24%; cross-checks with NPV = 19,781.30 at discount rate 8% (NPV>0 is consistent with IRR>discount rate).
